index_note: submission index is 0-based in file order; line = index + 1 (JSONL line number, JSON array position)

scenarios.title: radar-int03 degraded, failed and recovered
scenarios.description: Device health deteriorates, a sensor fault is reported, the device goes offline and later recovers. No observations from the device exist while it is offline.

expected_anomalies.detail: high temperature / packet loss and low-quality output before failure

expected_absences.detail: no observations expected while the device is offline; absence is not represented by events

scenarios.title: red-light violation with multiple sensor captures at Industrial-Ave-INT04
scenarios.description: One vehicle observed by radar/enforcement camera, ANPR and CCTV within seconds at the same site; plate and radar track id link the enforcement records, CCTV links only by time, place and appearance.

scenarios.title: Repeated denied access at Gate-C
scenarios.description: Several denied badge attempts with one credential, followed by camera and operator observations at the same door.

scenarios.title: Perimeter intrusion alarm at Perimeter-North
scenarios.description: Perimeter sensor alarm, camera detection, panel alarm and an operator follow-up at the same fence section.

scenarios.title: Same plate, contradictory vehicle details at Harbour-Rd-INT01
scenarios.description: ANPR and enforcement camera read the same plate seconds apart but report different make/colour (possible cloned plate or misread). A similar vehicle with a different plate passes shortly after and is unrelated.

expected_conflicts.detail: plate W 31643: gold Nissan vs silver Hyundai

scenarios.title: FLT-02 position trail delivered in reverse order
scenarios.description: A buffered GPS trail is uploaded after a coverage gap; records arrive newest-first.

expected_anomalies.detail: arrival order is the reverse of occurrence order

scenarios.title: Repeated motion alerts from cctv-perim-north
scenarios.description: One camera raises the same alert many times in 15 minutes (likely nuisance trigger).

scenarios.title: Two different vehicles at Harbour-Rd-INT01 within seconds
scenarios.description: Same place and almost the same time, different plates: separate observations.

scenarios.title: Person and partial plate in Car-Park-P2
scenarios.description: No track id and only a partial plate: there is no evidence that these observations are linked.

expected_uncertainty.detail: no stable identifier to link the person and the vehicle

scenarios.title: red-light violation with multiple sensor captures at Airport-Link-INT03
scenarios.description: One vehicle observed by radar/enforcement camera, ANPR and CCTV within seconds at the same site; plate and radar track id link the enforcement records, CCTV links only by time, place and appearance.

scenarios.title: Badge holder and recognised face disagree at Gate-A
scenarios.description: A credential belonging to one employee is used while face recognition matches a different enrolled employee at the same door (possible credential sharing or misidentification).

expected_conflicts.detail: credential holder EMP-1354 vs face match EMP-1186

scenarios.title: cctv-depot reports timestamps in the future
scenarios.description: The device clock runs ahead: occurred_at is later than received_at (suspicious but structurally valid).

expected_anomalies.detail: received_at earlier than occurred_at by about 493s

scenarios.title: Spike of denied access at Gate-B
scenarios.description: Many different valid staff credentials denied within 5 minutes (reader fault or controller sync issue, not one intruder).

expected_anomalies.detail: 10 denials across different credentials in 5 minutes

scenarios.title: Access denial and fence alarm in the same minute
scenarios.description: Simultaneous events in different areas with no shared subject: separate.

scenarios.title: Vague report and later weak fence alert at Perimeter-East
scenarios.description: Same area, half an hour apart, no shared identifier: possibly related, cannot be confirmed.

scenarios.title: Radar and enforcement camera timestamps disagree at Expressway-Exit21-INT06
scenarios.description: The violation record references the radar track id of a radar event but its occurred_at is several minutes earlier (camera clock drift).

expected_conflicts.detail: same radar track T16863, occurred_at differs by 571s

scenarios.title: Password-guessing burst against emp1039
scenarios.description: Burst of failed logins from one external address, followed by a success (possible account compromise).

scenarios.title: Two speeding measurements by radar-int04
scenarios.description: Same device, same event type, different radar tracks minutes apart: different vehicles.

scenarios.title: Weak face candidate and a different badge holder at Gate-B
scenarios.description: Evidence points to different people but the face match is too weak to call it a conflict; unresolved.

expected_uncertainty.detail: face candidate EMP-1146 (0.58) vs credential holder EMP-1064

scenarios.title: Fleet vehicle FLT-02 reported in two distant places
scenarios.description: GPS places the vehicle at the depot while ANPR at Airport-Link-INT03, 5.2 km away, reads its plate 40 seconds later (GPS fault or cloned plate).

scenarios.title: Cluster of speeding violations at Harbour-Rd-INT01
scenarios.description: Many different vehicles speeding at one site within 20 minutes: a location trend, not one incident.

scenarios.title: Red-light violations at two intersections in the same minute
scenarios.description: Similar event types, different places and vehicles: no relationship.

scenarios.title: Network alert with no asset or location mapping
scenarios.description: Internal host is not in the asset register; the alert cannot be tied to a site or device.

expected_uncertainty.detail: no location and unknown asset owner

scenarios.title: Fence sensor alarm not confirmed by camera at Perimeter-North
scenarios.description: The fence sensor reports a cut while the camera covering the section reports no activity seconds later.

expected_conflicts.detail: fence_cut alarm vs camera verification no_activity
